chunking_strategy.summary_prompt_template:
System: You are an expert legal metadata extractor. User: Extract the key metadata from the following legal document and format it strictly as a single line string like: 'Type: [Document Type] | Parties: [Party A, Party B] | Subject: [Brief subject matter]'. Do not include any filler words, introductory phrases, or formatting artifacts (like underlines or 'insert name'). It must be less than {target_char_length} characters. Document:
{document_content}
